[SWS_CM_00231] Behavior of a ServiceProxy over a secure channel using a reliable transport protocol before the secure channel is established
⌈
If a secure channel is configured for a ServiceProxy, futures returned by the Ser-
viceProxy’s methods shall only be satisfied after the configured secure channel was
successfully established, or if the secure channel could not be established. These
include:
• the function call operator (operator()) of the respective Method class (see
[SWS_CM_00196])
• the Set() method of the respective Field class (see [SWS_CM_00113])
• the Get() method of the respective Field class (see [SWS_CM_00112])
Methods, which immediately return shall return the error code ComErrc::kCommuni-
cationFailure if the secure channel is not established. In case the chosen security
protocol is able to protect Service Discovery this shall additionally be applied service
discovery APIs like FindService().
If the secure channel could not be established, the error code ComErrc::kCommuni-
cationFailure shall be returned in the Future of the respective methods (opera-
tor(), Set(), Get()).
⌋
